project.styleDefinitionBrief: Mobile education app, deep teal primary + warm neutral surfaces, PingFang SC, bottom tab navigation, single-column card layout, touch-friendly targets
project.designRead: Mobile EdTech app / junior-high students / calm data-driven / medium density touch-optimized / avoid desktop sidebar patterns

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: single deep teal #1B6B5A for primary CTA, progress bars, active tab, and skill indicators

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius: sm=4px, md=8px, lg=12px, xl=16px, full=9999px
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: PingFang SC primary stack; mobile-optimized sizes (14px body, 18px headings)
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: clean bordered cards, minimal shadow, touch-friendly 44px min tap targets
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: inline SVG icons, data visualization over photography

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: no sidebar; top bar with page title + notification bell; bottom fixed tab bar with 4 tabs (首页/诊断/练习/考试)
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: borders for cards; shadow-float for modals only
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: filled primary buttons with 8px radius, full-width on mobile, 44px min height
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: single column, 16px horizontal padding, 12-16px vertical gap
